runs.name: mid-context-views-4
runs.notes: At most four context views per step rather than twelve. The runs so far split on this and nothing else: twelve views win the sparse budgets by ten dB and lose the dense ones, two views hold the dense budgets and win little anywhere else. What separates them is how hard a step thins, since the views set what is predicted and the budget is capped either way, so four views is the middle of that trade rather than a new direction.

runs.name: dense-fields-180k
runs.notes: As dense a training field as this card holds, 180k Gaussians over at most six context views. Tests the standing failure directly: the two dense validation budgets are far past anything a step has ever refined, and they are where refinement loses PSNR rather than winning it.

runs.name: nvs-only-supervision
runs.notes: Photometric loss on the held-out views alone rather than on those plus the context views. Tests whether supervising only novel views buys generalization, both to the held-out reconstructor and to the views validation actually scores.

runs.name: lr-3x-cosine
runs.notes: Three times SplatFormer's second-stage rates, annealed. Tests whether 2000 steps at 3e-5 is simply too little movement, with the anneal there to keep the end of the run from paying for the larger steps.
